summary: Iter26 Phase 1 (AI Business Assistant + Trip Templates + Duplicate Trip) fully verified. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter26_phase1_ai_templates.py with 14 tests covering Templates CRUD + company scoping, Duplicate Trip reset logic, from-template prefill, AI SSE streaming, session persistence, and multi-company AI scoping — all 14 passed. Full regression of the 6-file standing suite (iter17, iter21, iter22, iter23, multi_company_iso, iter25) all 64 passed. Frontend Playwright smoke via localStorage-seeded auth confirmed: /trips/templates page loads, template-new opens form, template-save persists (form dismissed), Duplicate button rendered per trip row, AI chat bubble opens with panel/input/send + streams a response within 15s, and nav-templates sidebar link is present. Grand total: 14 new + 64 regression = 78/78 backend tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: trips.py trip_import(): the loop reassigns the outer `cid` (active company id) to each row's customer id (line ~230). Doesn't affect correctness because `cid` isn't reused after that, but it shadows an important variable — rename local to `cust_id` for clarity.

TripTemplate.freight_mode allows Literal['per_ton','round_trip','fixed'] but Trip.freight_mode only allows Literal['per_ton','fixed']. If a user creates a template with freight_mode='round_trip', POST /trips using the from-template prefill will fail validation. Either add 'round_trip' to Trip or drop it from TripTemplate.

ai.py event_stream(): if the LLM raises after some text chunks were yielded, `type:done` is never emitted — clients will hang waiting for it. Consider always yielding a terminal event in finally (in addition to persisting).

ai.py: session_id used with LlmChat is the same value across companies (both scoped by user + company internally). Not a bug for scoping (tools enforce cid) but worth noting: if the same user has two companies with same-length message history, they still get different chat sessions because we key on the generated `chat_...` id.

templates.py create_template returns the doc with `_id` popped but does NOT remove `user_id` before returning (`user_id` is added at line 30, only popped in list/get/put paths, but create returns `doc` after popping only `_id`). Minor info leak — user_id is not sensitive here but be consistent.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_bitumen_2026 (backend auto-provisions owner@vbklogistics.test). X-Company-Id header for company scoping.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_IT26_<hash>_CompA / CompB companies created per module run with TEST_ prefixed customers/templates/trips. Cleanup fixture deletes tagged templates + chat sessions on teardown; trips remain but are namespaced by TAG.

Multi-company AI scoping test seeds trips in both A (10k) and B (50k) and validates: (a) trip/data isolation (list_trips per cid), (b) chat session_id differs between companies, (c) session listing does not leak sessions across companies. Gemini network call takes ~2-5s so total suite is ~15s for iter26. Note the code review comments — a couple of easy cleanups worth flagging to E1.
